title: Black Henna with Hibiscus Hair Colour

details.description: Banjara's Black Henna with Hibiscus and henna gives naturally black hair with 100% grey coverage, without the worry of hair fall. 50 g pack of 5 sachets of 10 g.
details.ingredients: Natural Henna, Hibiscus, Neeli and Para-phenylenediamine
details.usageInstructions: Wash hair with shampoo, dry it, mix the powder with water in a non-metallic bowl to form a paste and apply on the hair as directed on the pack. Rinse well with water.
details.manufacturerName: Vishal Personal Care Pvt. Ltd. Sy. No.165/A
details.dangerWarnings: Caution: This product contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation or serious inflammation in certain cases, so a preliminary test according to the accompanying instructions should first be made. This product should not be used for dyeing the eyelashes or eyebrows; such usage may cause blindness. Pregnant and lactating mothers, please consult a doctor before use. Avoid contact with eyes or any mucus membrane. Keep out of reach of children. Hypersensitivity test: always perform the test 48 hours before each application. Mix a small quantity of powder with 1-2 drops of water and apply on previously washed and dried skin behind the ear. Allow it to dry for 20-30 minutes, then wash with soap and water and observe. The product can be considered safe for use if no reddening, burning, itching or swelling is experienced in or around the test area for 48 hours. For external use only.
